preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (deployer) to exploit this vulnerability

exploit_hint: The contract uses a constructor instead of an initializer function, making it vulnerable to front-running attacks. As the owner, deploy a malicious contract that calls the Advisory constructor with tokenAdd = address(0), subsequentClaims = 0, and timestamp = 1. This will set the token address to zero, breaking all token-related functionality. Then call failcase() to drain any native ETH from the contract.
